Meerkat Finance is a decentralized finance protocol that operates on the BNB Smart Chain. Meerkat Finance offers yield farming and auto-compounding vault services. Meerkat Finance was exploited in April 2022.

Terra is a blockchain platform built with the Cosmos SDK that uses proof-of-stake consensus. Terra supports algorithmic stablecoins such as UST. Terra's ecosystem collapsed in May 2022.

Luna is the native token of the Terra blockchain. Luna is used to absorb volatility and help stabilize the value of the UST stablecoin. Luna's value collapsed in May 2022.

SushiSwap is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. SushiSwap was forked from Uniswap in 2020. SushiSwap is governed by holders of its SUSHI token and offers liquidity pools and yield farming.
